short_scenes.caption: Mia's secret.
short_scenes.narration: As John healed, Mia showed him a secret. Two stones. She struck them together. A spark jumped.

short_scenes.caption: FIRE.
short_scenes.narration: She fed the spark with dry grass, and it grew into flame. Fire. Light in the dark. Warmth in the cold.

short_scenes.caption: Their first kiss.
short_scenes.narration: In the firelight, John took her hand. And under the stars, for the very first time, they kissed.

short_scenes.caption: But the fire could be seen…
short_scenes.narration: But fire can be seen from very far away. And on the hill, someone was watching.

short_scenes.caption: Who was watching them? Comment your guess!
short_scenes.narration: Who was watching them? Comment your guess below. Follow so you don't miss the next part.
